title: NEW Puffco Proxy WAX/OIL Portable Vaporizer (taxes extra)
description:
The NEW Puffco Proxy

NOW AVAILABLE

The new Proxy is smarter, smoother, and more powerful. A refined shape delivers bigger, cleaner hits with a refined feel in your hand. The upgraded 3D Chamber unlocks bigger dabs, better flavor, and reduces splash out. Bluetooth control via the Puffco Connect App puts full control of temp, session time, vapor level, and mood lighting in your hands. With improved battery life and compatibility with all Proxy pieces, it’s the Proxy you know—now evolved to take you further.

Product Features:
3D chamber
Real time temperature control
Connected app control
Up to 15 dabs per charge
USB-C charging

What’s Included:
1 x Proxy Base
1 x Proxy 3D Chamber
1 x Joystick Cap
1 x Glass Pipe
1 x USB-C Cable
1 x Loading Tool
Cotton Swabs

Warranty
For any device or troubleshooting issues, please email support@puffco.com
For warranty Service follow this link.
